structure: Part 4 of repos/trade-imports-animals-frontend at main 4c2119da: the notification hub (the 'Overview' task list) and the first journey page, origin. Read in full: features/hub/controller.js (178 lines: route, six section groups, status tags, row hiding, commodity totals, Review and submit and Return to dashboard buttons), hub/template.njk, hub/copy/copy.en.js and copy.cy.js (Welsh is a machine draft with matching keys), hub/hub.fit.spec.js (4 describe blocks, 24 tests); features/origin/page.js, evaluation.js (five fields bound to obligations), controller.js (GET/POST, back link, save and recoverable error, next page), template.njk (country type-ahead, region-code Yes/No with conditional prefixed box, internal reference, save actions), validate.js (rules, region-code prefix mechanics, blanking), copy/copy.en.js and copy.cy.js, origin.fit.spec.js (6 describe blocks, 33 tests); flow/task-rows.js (12 task rows, their pages and parts, the conditional identification and transit-countries rows). The shared save-actions macro, shared copy (saveActions, journeyStrip, validator oneOf default) and shared/paths.js were looked up only to resolve labels and routes these files use; the shared layout itself is part 1's. Claims cover the hub route, heading, commodity totals panel, task-list heading, six numbered section headings, every row title, hint, link and status tag, row hiding, the absent cannot-start state, the review button and dashboard button; the origin route, heading, every field with label, hint, options and optionality, every validation rule with its English error verbatim, region-code prefix behaviour, back link and save outcomes; and every fit test in both specs.
